lines.l: But now it's over and I must remember to forget her face
Cheap souvenirs and photographs in yesterday's trash
I'm walking down the street with the Paris rain on my back
We knew that it was over long ago
Seven years of riding on a train that can't get you on
There's some sunshine up the road
And someday I won't find out where it's at
But tonight I walk the street with the Paris rain on my back
